sources.title: LiquidAI/d1-3B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: d1-3B-GGUF d1-3B is a decision model developed by Liquid AI: it answers named, typed questions over a state (text, JSON or images) in one forward pass, with no generated tokens.

sources.title: Introducing d1: The most capable decision model, now with vision
sources.snippet: d1, Liquid AI's decision model, now handles text and images. It matches or beats GPT-6.1 Sol on 4 of 6 real tasks.

sources.snippet: Tip @liquidai 2026-09-29: multilingual evals, prompt-injection robustness, longer inputs, OpenRouter soon. No first-party context length or $/1M rate card published this pass — pmid d1:free implies free tier ($0/$0 on liquid join).
